'''Mingzhi''' is an NPC Liondance Troupe member in {{Location|Jinzhou}}, near the Jinhzou Theater stage. He can be found next to [[Chie]].

==Location== 
{{Map Embed|Jinzhou|94|nogroup=1}}

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events|Mingzhi}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Mingzhi:''' Hey, Rover! What's up?
:'''Mingzhi:''' Would you like to join our Liondance Troupe? Haha, just kidding.
{{Dialogue End}}

----
===Event Dialogue===
====By Moon's Grace====
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(First interaction)
:'''Mingzhi:''' Rover! Good to see you here!
:{{DIcon}} Hey! What brings you here?
:'''Mingzhi:''' The Liondance Troupe performed on the commercial street earlier, on those Plum Blossom Poles, and the crowd loved it.
:'''Mingzhi:''' So I was thinking, why not do it again at the Moonlit Fair? Everyone could give it a try.
:'''Mingzhi:''' After all, festivals are all about having fun, right? The more, the merrier!
----
:{{DIcon}} Chat
::'''Mingzhi:''' Have you ever met [[Xiuyi]], Rover? He used to perform on the commercial street.
::'''Mingzhi:''' We're both in the Liondance Troupe. If you've seen his performances, you might recognize the Plum Blossom Pole dance.
::'''Mingzhi:''' We haven't celebrated the Moonlit Fair in so long. This year is our chance to set up a stall to promote our troupe's services.
::'''Mingzhi:''' Ahem... It's not just about business. It's also about introducing more people to the Liondance.
::'''Mingzhi:''' When I get some free time, I'll show you the dance myself! I need to keep my skills sharp.
::'''Mingzhi:''' 
:{{DIcon|Exit}} Leave
{{Dialogue End}}
